title: Pricing matrices keeps its sort after a matrix is created, edited or deleted
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with the Settings - Parts permission.
  • Pricing matrix {Matrix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC38 alpha) exists.
  • Pricing matrix {Matrix-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC38 Beta) exists.
  • Pricing matrix {Matrix-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC38 rate 9) exists.
  • No pricing matrix named {Matrix-D} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC38 gamma) exists yet. The test creates it.
  • No pricing matrix named {Matrix-E} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC38 Delta) exists yet. The test renames {Matrix-B} to it.
  • Category {Category-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC38 spare) is not used by any pricing matrix, ready for the new matrix.
  • You are on a page other than Pricing and the Pricing Search box is empty.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings and click Pricing in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  2. Click the Pricing matrices tab.
  3. Click the Matrix Category column header once, so the list is Z to A.
  4. Click New Price Matrix.
  5. Type {Matrix-D} as the Name.
  6. Choose {Category-A} in the Category list.
  7. Add one rule row (for example Min Cost 0, Max Cost 1000, Markup % 10).
  8. Save the dialog.
  9. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  10. Read the header arrow and the order of the tagged matrices.
  11. Click the edit icon on {Matrix-B}.
  12. Change its Name to {Matrix-E}.
  13. Save the dialog.
  14. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  15. Read the header arrow and the order of the tagged matrices.
  16. Click the delete icon on {Matrix-C}.
  17. Confirm the deletion.
  18. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  19. Read the header arrow and the order of the tagged matrices.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 10: the header arrow still points down and the rows read {Matrix-C}, {Matrix-D}, {Matrix-B}, {Matrix-A} (rate 9, gamma, Beta, alpha), Z to A.
  • Step 15: the arrow still points down and the rows read {Matrix-C}, {Matrix-D}, {Matrix-E}, {Matrix-A} (rate 9, gamma, Delta, alpha).
  • Step 19: the arrow still points down and the rows read {Matrix-D}, {Matrix-E}, {Matrix-A} (gamma, Delta, alpha). The list did not go back to A to Z.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11258; story SV-10135 (Story 2, Pricing Matrices, sortable column; story text re-synced to the PRD on 13 Oct 2026); PRD "Settings Pricing And Categories Sorting (Price/Category)", Confluence 578781186, version 21 (14 Oct 2026), S2-R8 and the Story 2 context note, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.3 (Pricing matrices), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R8: “When the list reloads in place, the sort the user chose stays applied and the header arrow stays where it was.”
  • PRD Story 2 context note: “The list reloads when the user creates, edits or deletes a pricing matrix.”
